summary: Mission Control on the existing work_items ledger: workspace (operations | platform), requested_by, why, blocks (dependency keys), next_step, evidence_required, action_url, module_key, horizon (now/next/later), links (GitHub issues, PRs, deployments); source_type gains agent and platform; an open item's source_ref is unique (agent de-duplication); work_item_events audit trail. Creates no journal entry, ledger row or balance.

preflight.name: work_items exists
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'work_items'

preflight.name: workspace not added yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'work_items' AND column_name = 'workspace'

preflight.name: no duplicate open source_ref
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM (SELECT source_ref FROM work_items WHERE source_ref IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('new','in_progress','waiting') GROUP BY source_ref HAVING count(*) > 1) d

expected_changes: work_items gains 10 columns (all nullable or defaulted; existing rows become workspace 'operations', blocks [] and links []).
work_items source_type check now also allows agent and platform.
New table work_item_events (audit trail) with service_role grants.

verify.name: columns exist
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'work_items' AND column_name IN ('workspace','requested_by','why','blocks','next_step','evidence_required','action_url','module_key','horizon','links')

verify.name: events table exists
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'work_item_events'

verify.name: existing rows are operations
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM work_items WHERE workspace <> 'operations'
